svg.text: A ravine: plain gradient descent zigzags, momentum rolls along the floor
f(w₁, w₂) = ½(w₁² + 25 w₂²), drawn to scale: 25× steeper across the ravine than along it. Same start, same learning rate.
Momentum: v ← 0.7·v + ∇f, then w ← w − 0.07·v. Across the ravine the gradient flips sign and cancels in v; along it, it adds up.
